messages:
Priya: quick sync on the metrics panel visuals. noticed axis labels flip to scientific notation for large mem values and its weird at 1.2e+03. Can we make notation human-friendly by default?
Sam: yes let's avoid e-notation in UI. rule: use plain integers up to millions, then use 1.2M, 1.2G, etc. only for >= 1e6. also allow user override to force scientific in export.
Ethan: about smoothing: two options in the mock  bezier vs moving-average. bezier looks smoother but hides sharp spikes. moving-average preserves peaks better. we need a third: "preserve outliers" mode that applies a median filter but overlays sentinel markers for points beyond 3 sigma.
Rafa: sentinel markers are good. visual: small hollow circle + 2px halo color. also show a tooltip that says "outlier: value X at t". ensure marker size accessible at 14px target on high-dpi.
Priya: legend behavior: current hover dims others. some PMs prefer muting others on click, not hover. suggestion: hover = temporary highlight (no dom change), click = pin series (dim rest). add keyboard focus support to toggle pins.
Sam: axis ticks: for ranges < 1 use 0.01 increments, but for ranges crossing zero we should use symmetric ticks and include zero always. avoid odd tick numbers like 0.0003 shown. use nice rounding to 2 sig figs for floats.
Ethan: log scale request from infra dashboards. add a small toggle per-chart: linear | log. show small helper: "log scale compresses wide ranges; not suitable for negative values". aria-live region update needed when user switches scales.
Rafa: copy nit: "normalize per second" vs "per-second average". I prefer "per second (avg)" in compact labels. long form in tooltip: "average per second over selected window".
Priya: accessibility: screen reader should announce legend items and whether series is pinned/hidden. use aria-pressed for pin state and aria-describedby for sentinel explanation. add unit readouts like "1.2 thousand" for SR.
Sam: CSV export: include raw and display columns: value_raw, value_display, unit. Avoid rounding in raw. Document this in csv-spec.md.
Ethan: tests: add visual regression for smoothing modes and sentinel visibility. include fixture where a single spike exists among flat series.
Rafa: I'll prototype sentinel style and keyboard pins. Priya can help with microcopy.
designbot: New task created: https://design.redwood/tasks/CHART-2184  assignees: Rafa, Priya, Sam  due in 5 days :calendar:
Priya: great. small ask: can we add a tiny sample in the PR showing log vs linear and a11y narration transcript? helps reviewers.
Sam: will include csv-spec.md and aria transcripts.
Ethan: thanks all, will file PR after mock fixes. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread export; concise messages with action items as required by agents.md
